title: Good, lucky or in trouble?
dek: All 30 teams: record vs. how much they win by.

beats.title: Winning big, every night
beats.text: Spurs and Celtics are 10-2 at +11.2 a game. The Wolves are +11.1.

beats.title: Lakers: 11-2, +8.0
beats.text: A bit above the line. Turnovers fuel it: 24.5 points off them a game, most in the NBA.

beats.title: 76ers: 9-3, only +1.0
beats.text: A league-best 8-0 in clutch games. Records like that usually cool off.

beats.title: Knicks: 6-5, but +6.8
beats.text: Margins that big usually come with more wins. The Raptors (5-6, +2.6) are below the line too.

beats.title: Four teams with one win
beats.text: Bucks, Bulls, Kings and Jazz are losing by 11.5 to 15.5 points a game.

sources: Records and point differential: Yahoo Sports standings through Nov 11, checked against CBS Sports. 76ers clutch record: CBS Sports. Lakers points off turnovers: team stats via Heavy. The line is the best fit through all 30 teams.
